Sudarsan Ghosh

Senior AI Engineer

Address India

Phone +918250390671

E-mail sudarsan.ghosh.web@gmail.com

Senior AI Engineer specializing in Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and Agentic AI. Skilled in building and optimizing AI models for real-world use, including edge devices and LLM-based systems. Experienced in delivering privacy-focused solutions, real-time analytics, and open-source contributions with proven impact across research and industry.

Work History

2024-02 - Current	AI Consultant

Sony India Software Centre

Optimized CNN architectures for Sony's IMX500 edge processor, achieving real- time performance through hardware-aware model modifications, custom layer reconfiguration, and quantization, improving on-device efficiency, and performing model training for benchmarking accuracy.

Designed and deployed an advanced RAG-based Document QA system with

OCR for tabular and structured PDFs (spec sheets, manuals, FAQs), enabling an intelligent internal support chatbot that improved information retrieval efficiency.

Implemented Agentic AI workflows with GitHub MCP, automating detection of

OSS vulnerabilities and raising internal GitHub issues, strengthening proactive security and compliance processes.

Contributed to PyTorch open source with new feature requests and bug fixes,

influencing community-driven improvements.

Delivered proof-of-concept Parking Monitoring System with real-time analytics, enhancing internal capabilities for People Monitoring & Activity Recognition projects.

2022-01 - 2024-01	Senior AI Engineer

GyrusAI

Led Face Anonymization project using GANs to ensure privacy in video data.

Designed cloud-ready 3D Pose Estimation & Activity Recognition for Driver Monitoring Systems.

Delivered density-based People Counting & Anomaly Detection for edge

cameras.

Researched Transformer/Attention models for class-agnostic counting & segmentation.

2019-10 - 2021-12	Machine Learning Engineer



Gyrus AI

Researched 3D reconstruction with NeRF for mesh generation..

Developed solutions in Video Compression Artifact Removal, Motion Blur Reduction, Super-Resolution using GANs.

Built scalable Video Analytics systems: pose estimation, anomaly detection,

object tracking.

Optimized DL models for fast inference on hardware accelerators.

Freelance

Developed industrial Defect Detection system with optimized deployment on Jetson Nano.
